## Summary

Describe the observable outcome and why it belongs in this plugin.

## Related issue

Link the issue, or explain why this is a small correction that does not need one.

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks run.

## Impact checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior, failure path, and lifecycle cleanup that changed.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation describe the same current behavior.
- [ ] Package exports and packed files were checked when they changed.
- [ ] File, network, process, credential, persistence, telemetry, and model-context effects are documented.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, machine-specific paths, or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes and limitations are stated explicitly.
